WITH per_event AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
  FROM budget
  WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM per_event
),
kept AS (
  SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall
  FROM per_event p, overall o
  WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS kept_avg FROM kept
)
SELECT k.link_to_event, k.avg_amount, k.above_overall, k.avg_amount - km.kept_avg AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept k, kept_mean km
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
